# St. Barths Massage by Tranquilitas

Luxury mobile massage service across Saint Barthélemy.

Canonical site: https://stbarthsmassage.com/

Primary services: Swedish Massage, Deep Tissue Massage, Couples Massage, Sports Massage, Villa Massage, Hotel / In-Room Massage, Yacht Massage, Mobile Massage, and beach-adjacent requests.

Current published prices from the source site: Swedish / Deep Tissue / Sports €207 for 60 min and €299 for 90 min; Couples €414 for 60 min and €598 for 90 min; Yacht and beach-adjacent logistics are confirmed by request.

Service areas: Gustavia, St. Jean, Flamands, Colombier, Grand Cul-de-Sac, Saline, Gouverneur, Lurin and Lorient, plus suitable private addresses across the island.

Booking requests are pending until therapist availability and property access are confirmed.
